regulator: IN-SPACe (Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre)
liability_framework: Governed by Indian Space Policy 2023 & IN-SPACe NGP. Operators must obtain mandatory third-party liability insurance as specified per authorization; State retains treaty responsibility under OST 1967.
licensing_model: Single-Window Authorization (IN-SPACe acts as autonomous single-window nodal agency for all non-government space activities)
resource_rights: Signatory to Artemis Accords (2023). ISP 2023 mandates compliance with international obligations; no standalone domestic space mining legislation enacted yet.

fdi_cap_satellites: 100% (Subject to CFIUS national security review; FCC foreign ownership limit of 25% for direct licenses unless waived)
fdi_cap_launch_vehicles: 100% (Subject to CFIUS national security review and ITAR/EAR export control restrictions)
fdi_cap_ground_segment: 100% (Subject to FCC spectrum licensing and CFIUS review)
liability_framework: Three-tier statutory indemnification model under CSLA (51 U.S.C. Ch. 509). Licensees purchase Maximum Probable Loss (MPL) insurance (capped at $500M launch / $100M third-party); US Government indemnifies third-party claims above MPL up to ~$3B+.
licensing_model: Multi-Agency Regulatory Model (Split regulatory jurisdiction requiring separate approvals across FAA/AST, FCC, NOAA, and Department of State).
resource_rights: Explicit statutory commercial ownership rights for extracted space resources granted under US Commercial Space Launch Competitiveness Act of 2015 (51 U.S.C. 51302); Artemis Accords co-founder.

regulator: Luxembourg Space Agency (LSA) / Ministry of the Economy
fdi_cap_satellites: 100% Automatic (Open EU market subject to standard EU national security screening)
fdi_cap_launch_vehicles: 100% Automatic (Open EU market subject to standard EU launch safety and security screening)
liability_framework: Article 12 of the Law of July 20, 2017 requires operators to maintain third-party liability insurance; State may grant indemnification coverage caps per operational license.
licensing_model: Single-Window Licensing Framework via Luxembourg Space Agency (LSA) and Ministry of the Economy for commercial space resource exploration and satellite operations.
resource_rights: Explicit statutory rights under the Law of July 20, 2017 on the Exploration and Use of Space Resources declaring space resources subject to private commercial ownership; Artemis Accords co-founder.

fdi_cap_satellites: 100% Automatic (Following 2019 Federal Space Law and national FDI Law reforms; subject to UAESA approval)
fdi_cap_launch_vehicles: 100% Automatic (Subject to UAESA security licensing and strategic sector review)
liability_framework: Federal Law No. 12 of 2019 mandates third-party liability insurance for space operators; UAE Cabinet establishes minimum financial coverage thresholds per mission.
licensing_model: Single-Window Regulatory Model under UAE Space Agency (UAESA) issuing permits for launch, satellite operations, and space object registrations.
resource_rights: Explicit provisions in Federal Law No. 12 of 2019 allowing commercial exploitation and ownership of space resources in compliance with international treaties; Artemis Accords co-founder.
